S05.meta: // SLIDE 05 — ALPHA-BETA RATIO: High vs low α/β — the asymmetry fractionation exploits

data.question: How does tissue type respond to fraction size?

branches.label: HIGH α/β ~10 Gy — tumors + acute tissues
branches.detail: Skin, mucosa, marrow. Shallow survival-curve shoulder — fraction size matters relatively little. Total dose dominates.

branches.label: LOW α/β ~3 Gy — late-responding tissues
branches.detail: Spinal cord, brain, kidney. Pronounced shoulder — disproportionately damaged by large fractions.
branches.fix: Very sensitive to fraction size — protected by small daily doses

resolver.label: Small fractions exploit the asymmetry
resolver.detail: Daily 2 Gy fractions punish the tumor while allowing the spinal cord to repair between fractions. Large fractions collapse that advantage.
